definitions.explanation: Describes something that happens many times or at short intervals. More formal than よく and emphasizes the high frequency or repetition.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻繁|ひんぱん}に⟦{起|お}きる→起きる：00521_okiru⟧。
⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧、{頻繁|ひんぱん}に⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Lately I've been getting headaches frequently.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{交差点|こうさてん}→交差点：01404_kousaten⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻繁|ひんぱん}に⟦{発生|はっせい}している→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{信号機|しんごうき}→信号機：27201_shingouki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Accidents were occurring so frequently at this intersection that a traffic light was installed.

notes:
USAGE:
{頻繁|ひんぱん}に is more formal and emphatic than ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ (often). It stresses the high frequency or closeness of intervals, and is common in news, reports, and formal writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
⟦{頻繁|ひんぱん}→頻繁：08631_hinpan⟧ is a na-adjective that can also be used predicatively: ⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頻繁|ひんぱん}だ (Contact is frequent). The adverbial form {頻繁|ひんぱん}に is more commonly used.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧ — general "often," neutral register
- {頻繁|ひんぱん}に — emphasizes high frequency, somewhat formal
- ⟦しょっちゅう→しょっちゅう：10343_shocchuu⟧ — "all the time," informal, sometimes implies annoyance
- ⟦しばしば→しばしば：02365_shibashiba⟧ — "often," literary/written style
